title: Enforcement Rules of the Polar Activities Promotion Act
full_text:
⊙ Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries No. 501
The Ordinance Enacting the Enforcement Rules of the Polar Activities Promotion Act is hereby promulgated as follows.

October 12, 2021
Minister of Oceans and Fisheries (Seal)

Enforcement Rules of the Polar Activities Promotion Act

[Omitted because identical to the main text]

ADDENDUM
These Rules shall enter into force on October 14, 2021.

[Enactment]

◇ Reasons for Enactment and Main Contents

The Polar Activities Promotion Act and its Enforcement Decree were enacted to provide, among other things, for surveys on the current status of polar activities and for the establishment and operation of an integrated polar information system, in order to systematically foster and support polar activities in response to the growing need to manage, conserve, develop and use the polar environment and resources. Accordingly, these Rules prescribe matters delegated by the Act and the Presidential Decree, including procedures for on-site investigations conducted as part of those surveys, the types of information that must be included in the integrated polar information system, and procedures for requesting the submission of data necessary to establish and operate that system.

enactment-amendment-reason.source_quote:
[제정]


◇ 제정이유 및 주요내용


  극지 환경 및 자원의 관리ㆍ보전ㆍ개발ㆍ이용의 필요성이 커지는 추세에 맞추어 극지활동을 체계적으로 육성ㆍ지원하기 위해 극지활동 등에 대한 실태조사를 실시하고, 극지통합정보시스템을 구축ㆍ운영하도록 하는 등의 내용으로 「극지활동 진흥법」 및 같은 법 시행령이 제정됨에 따라, 실태조사 중 현지조사의 절차, 극지통합정보시스템에 포함되어야 하는 정보의 종류와 극지통합정보시스템의 구축ㆍ운영에 필요한 자료의 제출 요청 절차 등 법률 및 대통령령에서 위임된 사항을 정하려는 것임.
